seed_ledger.name: Nueva Era Dos Pipeline Project
seed_ledger.reason: NO_DC_TIE. Real FERC border crossing (docket CP25-527, Nueva Era Dos LLC): about 3,603 ft of 36 in pipe, Maverick County TX to Coahuila, about 1 Bcf/d to unnamed Mexican industrial customers. Separate from roster row P0290. No source ties it to a data center, and no power plant or data center campus is named. The only Eagle Pass data center found is an MDC fiber site with no gas link. Searches run: 8. Sources checked: Federal Register environmental assessment notice (industrial customers only); web search on Eagle Pass data centers (fiber site only); prior-run notes on FERC docket, EIA row and Spanish-language search (nothing).

evidence.note: EA notice, border crossing for industrial customers

seed_ledger.name: Texas-Arkansas Power Project (TAPP)
seed_ledger.reason: NO_DC_TIE. Compression-only NGPL expansion (about 400,000 Dth/d, FERC CP26-46, in service Nov 2028) to serve gas power plants in Texas and Arkansas, including the cooperative's Naples, Texas plant. Coverage ties the plant to cooperative load and coal retirements, not to a named data center. Searches run: 8. Sources checked: Kinder Morgan project page (power plants, no data center); Power Engineering article on the Naples plant (cooperative load, no data center); Talk Business coverage (cooperative load); searches on data centers with the cooperative and NGPL (nothing).

seed_ledger.name: Waha to Mexico (Wahalajara System Expansion)
seed_ledger.reason: OUT_OF_SCOPE. Two turbo-compression units in Chihuahua and Aguascalientes, Mexico, raising capacity about 50 percent. No US facility. Data centers are named only as a generic Mexican demand sector. Searches run: 6. Sources checked: Pipeline and Gas Journal March 2026 (Mexican compression only); Pipeline and Gas Journal 2025 items and Siemens Energy coverage (generic sectors); search for FERC filings (none).

seed_ledger.name: Commonwealth Energy Connector Project
seed_ledger.reason: NO_DC_TIE. Real Transco project: about 6.35 mi of 24 in loop plus 33,000 HP at Station 168, Mecklenburg County VA, 105 MMcf/d for Virginia Natural Gas, approved by FERC Nov 2023. Not a roster row (P3200 VNG Interconnect is a different cancelled project). Filings cite reliability and Mid-Atlantic and Virginia Natural Gas growth, with no data center named. Data center coverage in the area names Power Express (P7800) instead. Searches run: 8. Sources checked: FERC final environmental impact statement notice (reliability and supply for the utility); Argus and S&P (generic demand); Cardinal News and Pipeline and Gas Journal (Power Express only); Virginia Mercury (context only).

evidence.note: FERC final EIS notice, project scope and purpose
